messages:
Maya C: Quick weekly Hearthly health check-in :wave: — high level: usage +3% w/w, spend trending +7% month-on-month, error rate jumped 0.8% -> 1.9% in last 24h. Main concern: p95/p99 by route/model (streaming vs non-streaming) shows a streaming-only regression on /chat-stream. Full snapshot below and action items.

Maya C: p95/p99 (24h window) — route /chat-stream — model rwd-7B-v2 — streaming: p95=230ms, p99=980ms (baseline last week p95=180ms p99=420ms). non-streaming same route/model => p95=190ms p99=440ms (flat).

Maya C: route /completion — model rwd-7B-v2 — streaming: p95=85ms p99=160ms, non-streaming: p95=80ms p99=150ms. So regression seems isolated to /chat-stream path.

Maya C: KV cache hit rate (Hearthly tenant) dropped 87% -> 62% around 2026-03-19T14:00Z which lines up with latency spike. Error breakdown: 63% slow responses (long tail), 22% timeouts retried, 15% 5xx infra.

Sam E: digging in infra — I see streaming-pool-2 (us-west2) saw sustained GPU util ~96% for ~45m around the spike. Autoscaler didn't spin up extra nodes due to a config throttle. Putting an override now. :wrench:

Li: can you paste a couple of sample request ids and logs? need to check KV miss patterns and whether the KVS eviction bumped tenant keys.

Maya C: sample logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-19T15:22:11Z] req=rid_abc123 route=/chat-stream model=rwd-7B-v2 tenant=hearthly p95=980ms p99=980ms err=""
[2026-03-19T15:22:13Z] req=rid_def456 route=/chat-stream model=rwd-7B-v2 tenant=hearthly p95=1020ms p99=1020ms err="timeout"
[2026-03-19T15:22:40Z] req=rid_ghi789 route=/chat-stream model=rwd-7B-v2 tenant=hearthly p95=450ms p99=450ms err=""
```

Maya C: console link (Hearthly): https://console.redwood.internal/accounts/hearthly/health — dashboard shows rolling p99 and KV hit heatmap.

Sam E: mitigation applied — temporarily routing Hearthly streaming traffic to streaming-pool-1 and enabling fallback to rwd-7B-v1 for streaming path if latency >700ms. Will monitor for 1h and revert. :ok_hand:

deploy-bot: Deploy notice — feature flag `hearthly_streaming_fallback` set to ON at 2026-03-19T16:04:10Z by Sam E.

Li: initial look — KV eviction spikes visible on the same timeframe, TTL pressure + a tenant-specific cache size reduction pushed in last week's config change. Reverting that change in staging to validate.

Jules: renewal risk update: renewal scoring bumped from low->medium due to repeated p99 spikes. Usage growth is promising but latency flags combined with spend increase raise concerns. CS action: schedule engineering deep-dive with Hearthly and propose a short-term SLO credit if we see another hit.

Ben: billing note — Hearthly monthly run-rate forecast now ~$18k (was $16k). If fallback increases non-streaming usage it may affect cost. cc @Maya C for customer messaging.

Maya C: action items: 1) Sam/E to confirm autoscaler override success + monitor p99 (owner: Sam E) 2) Li to validate KV config revert in staging and propose fix (owner: Li) 3) Maya to schedule customer call for Tue 10am PST and prepare short RCA + mitigation notes (owner: Maya C) 4) Ben to update spend forecast and prepare options for SLO credit (owner: Ben).

Maya C: short status in 45m — will post updates here. Thanks team. :seedling:
